READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST
An answer booklet is provided inside this question paper. You should follow the instructions on the front cover
of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
The number of marks is given in brackets [ ] at the end of each question or part question.
This syllabus is approved for use in England, Wales and Northern Ireland as a Cambridge International Level 1/Level 2 Certificate.
This document consists of 3 printed pages and 1 blank page.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–1918
1 How important was the failure of the Schlieffen Plan as a reason for the start of trench warfare in
1914? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were food shortages in the impact of the war on the British Home Front? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–1945
How important was proportional representation as a reason for the weakness of the Weimar
Republic? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were schools in bringing about the type of society the Nazis wanted? Explain your
answer.
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–1941
How important was the New Economic Policy (NEP) in consolidating Bolshevik control of Russia
after 1917? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were Stalin’s ideas about Communism in the Soviet Union as a reason for his
emergence as leader? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE USA, 1919–1941
How important were the social consequences of the Wall Street Crash in US political developments
up to 1933? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the Second New Deal in improving life for American people up to 1941? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was industrial reform in achieving Mao’s goals after 1949? Explain your answer.
How significant were the Red Guards in Mao establishing his dominance over Communist China?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was black migration to towns as a reason for the National Party’s victory in 1948?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the Rivonia Trial, 1963–1964, in suppressing opposition to apartheid? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was the role of Egypt in causing the wars with Israel, 1956–1973? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant have Palestinian groups been in limiting progress towards peace in the Middle
East? Explain your answer.
